description: This file defines WebSocket client logic for a gateway, including message framing, URL resolution, argument parsing, and WebSocket connection management.

methods.name: createArgReader
methods.description: Creates an argument reader object to parse command-line arguments.

methods.name: resolveGatewayUrl
methods.description: Resolves a raw URL string into a URL object, defaulting to wss or ws protocols and setting default ports.

methods.name: createGatewayWsClient
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket client for communicating with a gateway, handling request-response and event messages.
